scope: Read actual public apparatus, starter, completed shortcut, oracle, independent reference, grader, author derivation and completed validation/local-control reports. Verified hashes without numerical or model-agent reruns.
physics_findings: The coating has one common independent Markov state. For the mean density c_i=E[n(r) 1_(G=i)], linear diffusion, nonsaturating uptake and gate transitions close D Laplacian(c)+Q c=0. This equivalence to a one-particle switching-state system is limited to first moments; shared-gate count correlations are not assumed independent.

The finite instantaneous intrinsic reaction velocity, reflection of survivors, absence of stored surface particles, maintained far concentration and full joint stationary preparation uniquely define the switching Robin boundary. No additional resetting rule is required.

With pi=(k10,k01)/(k01+k10), radial stationary modes are pi, pi*a/r and (1,-1)*a/r*exp[-sqrt((k01+k10)/D)*(r-a)]. The oracle boundary columns have the correct D/a+kappa and D*(1/a+q)+kappa factors and negative forcing -pi*kappa. Positive uptake is -4*pi*a*D*A.

The completed source is a consistent positive, conservative spherical mean-Robin solution using stationary-averaged reactivity. Its dependence on the rate ratio while discarding total switching timescale is the fast-switching physical approximation, not an accidental missing input or incomplete equation solver.

Equal nonzero reactivities give exactly the common finite-reactivity capture law for every D. Its derivative 4*pi*a*(a*kappa)^2/(D+a*kappa)^2 is positive, so the calibration identifies diffusivity. Known radii/reactivities/rates and fixed instrument sigma contain no parameter side channel.

The private reference independently solves coupled radial concentrations and fluxes with inner Robin and finite outer reservoir boundaries, reads direct inner reaction and extrapolates three outer radii. It does not import or reproduce the oracle analytic mode amplitudes. Flux conservation and outer-radius refinement support the stated precision.

input_and_grading_review.docker_boundary: Only README, starter model, public test and public calibration are copied to /app.
input_and_grading_review.measurement: Positive number of captures per unit time at a single common coating; all particles count equally. Units and finite parameter domain are explicit.
input_and_grading_review.grading: Finite one-dimensional arrays, calibration, diffusivity recovery, three ordinary unequal-reactivity signal groups and equal-reactivity anchors. No implementation inspection.

existing_validation_review.limits: Finite-reactivity fast/slow switching, state relabeling, common rate scaling, no reaction, nonnegative joint density and particle conservation recorded in owner report.

bressloff.checked: Primary abstract confirms per-particle conformational switching and coupled Robin description. The common-gate first-moment adaptation is derived explicitly in AUTHOR and is not attributed as the paper apparatus.

szabo_1982.checked: AUTHOR labels this as bibliographic background only and discloses no full text was obtained. This review does not rely on its inaccessible full text.

classification_guidance: Later model trials must distinguish retaining the mean-reactivity physical closure from a recognized exact joint diffusion model followed by numerical or implementation error. No model difficulty or zero-of-three outcome is asserted by this peer review.
